Dear participant,

The purpose of this study is to examine how implementing Agile Methodology influences flexibility, stakeholder collaboration, and adaptive capabilities in Business Intelligence (BI) projects.

Your participation is voluntary, and your responses will remain anonymous and confidential. The collected data will be used solely for academic and research purposes.

The survey will take approximately 8–10 minutes to complete.By proceeding, you confirm that you have read and understood the purpose of this study and that you voluntarily agree to participate.
